_note: What a question to Outrider (POST /api/ask: the tablet app's voice) is matched to, without any AI. Each command lists phrases; a question matches the first command, in this order, that has one of its phrases as whole words in it (case and punctuation ignored; a leading "hey vespa" or "vespa" is dropped). Edit freely: a command's phrases can change, but its name stays (it picks the answer). Unmatched questions go to the AI layer when [assistant] enabled is true.
